description: Unit test module for Salary Structure functionality in ERPNext payroll module, including setup, holiday list creation, salary structure creation, and various test cases for deductions, totals, whitespace handling, assignment, and multi-currency support.

classes.name: TestSalaryStructure
classes.description: Unit test class for salary structure functionalities including setup, deduction calculations, totals, whitespace handling, assignment, and multi-currency support.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by clearing relevant tables, creating holiday list, setting default holiday list, and creating test employees.

methods.name: make_holiday_list
methods.description: Creates a holiday list with weekly off on Sunday if it does not already exist.

methods.name: test_salary_structure_deduction_based_on_gross_pay
methods.description: Tests deduction calculation based on gross pay in salary structure.

methods.name: test_amount_totals
methods.description: Verifies total earnings, deductions, gross pay, and net pay calculations.

methods.name: test_whitespaces_in_formula_conditions_fields
methods.description: Ensures that whitespace characters are stripped from formula and condition fields.

methods.name: test_salary_structures_assignment
methods.description: Tests assigning a salary structure to an employee and verifies assignment details.

methods.name: test_multi_currency_salary_structure
methods.description: Checks creation of a salary structure with a different currency (USD).
